answer: Bamboo spars lie in a bundle on the kite-maker bench, tissue paper stacked beside them. Proof of kite maker via layang frame tally — a kite the maker frames only after 31 kites hold their frame without one snapping at the spine, each framed by the maker himself. comet bends the spar over the knee and lashes it to the spine. ridge pastes the paper tight across the frame, no wrinkle anywhere. willow ties the bridle and tests the balance in the yard breeze. Thirty-one kites must hold their frame without one snapping at the spine, and the next still snaps where the bamboo was cut too thin.
